# Figure Skating Tools

> figureskatingtools.com is a set of open-source web tools that help figure skating result services, competition organisers and officials with competition paperwork, built from Figure Skating Manager (FS Manager) data. Supporting the figure skating community.

Only the front page is public. The tools themselves require sign-in, and access is by invitation; there is no public content to crawl behind the login.

## Tools

- Judge Paper Creator: builds each judge's set of papers from FS Manager PDF exports, in Finnish or English, and sends them by e-mail with a secure download link.
- Protocol Generator: produces the complete official protocol book (cover, competition info, time schedule, podiums, results, judges' details, synchronized skating team pages).
- Score Modifier: splits the FS Manager "Judges Details per Skater" export into one readable page per skater or team.
- GDPR Removal Tool: handles skaters' data-removal requests by replacing the name and club in published FS Manager result pages and PDFs, keeping placements and scores.
- Competition Banner Generator: creates a branded competition banner with name, dates, venue and federation and club logos.
- Live FS Manager link: FS Manager can push schedules, entries and PDFs to the platform while the event runs.
